technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 15ml, this KoColor POLISH is expertly formulated with Ethyl Acetate, Butyl Acetate, Nitrocellulose, Yellow 5 Lake, Blue 1 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Emerald Envy color profile (`#50C878`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
